description:
Query TikTok Ads performance insights using the current native/calculated metric catalog and query planning.
Use tiktok://metrics resource to see available metrics. Use tiktok://dimensions for dimensions.
Age/gender dimensions route automatically to AUDIENCE reports via tiktok_get_audience_report, including campaign/ad group levels. Other dimensions use the BASIC planner. Multiple audience breakdowns remain separate reports, never joined.

adIds.description: Restrict AUCTION_AD reports to these ad IDs, including daily trends.

adgroupIds.description: Restrict audience reports to these ad groups.

campaignIds.description: Restrict audience reports to these campaigns.

dataLevel.description: TikTok reporting aggregation level. Metrics and dimensions must be compatible with this level.

dimensions.description: Dimension keys from tiktok://dimensions (e.g., stat_time_day, campaign_id)

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

metrics.description: Metric keys from tiktok://metrics (e.g., spend, impressions, clicks)

orderField.description: Order the native report before limiting rows. Include this metric in metrics.

orderType.description: Native sort direction; defaults to DESC when orderField is selected.

queryLifetime.description: Query lifetime metrics (cannot use time dimensions)

reportType.description: Defaults to AUDIENCE for age/gender, BASIC otherwise. Explicit BASIC with demographics is rejected.

name: tiktok_get_insights

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: tiktok get insights
